scope: Exploratory post-hoc reranking of a CLAP-selected candidate pool, not a preregistered model or optimizer comparison.

checkCaptions.new-1: An accompaniment to a fast, mischievous getaway in a comic adventure: alert, rhythmically purposeful and restrained enough for reading.
checkCaptions.new-2: Instrumental music supporting danger and deadpan humour as a fugitive springs a trap, then keeps moving. Clear motion without an overwhelming foreground.

selection: Rank all 21 existing gate-eligible candidates using original seed only. Contrastive = target ensemble minus reflective caption. Fixed baselines: original pursuit and warm. No new mutations or selection using check results.
limitations: All semantic methods share the same CLAP encoder; no alternative-model inference is claimed.
Candidates were generated using the previous ensemble objective, which favours that method.
New seed and wording are development checks, not independent passage or human-label validation.
No listener ground truth is available; ranking agreement cannot establish quality.
